meta.frontend: classical precomputed-feature (Harris / Shi-Tomasi / ORB), NOT learned

detectors.harris: cv2.goodFeaturesToTrack(useHarrisDetector=True, blockSize=3, k=0.04, qualityLevel=0.001, minDistance=2, maxCorners=2000) on the grey RGB, then cv2.cornerSubPix(5x5, 20 it, 0.01)
detectors.shitomasi: cv2.goodFeaturesToTrack(qualityLevel=0.001, minDistance=2, maxCorners=2000) on the grey RGB, then cv2.cornerSubPix(5x5)
detectors.orb: cv2.ORB_create(nfeatures=2000).detectAndCompute with the visible mask; native keypoint positions (multi-scale FAST+Harris scoring)

gates.relaxed_note: >=3x the 10 reduced-cost parameters and >=15 off-plane points

meta.framing: Classical precomputed-feature front-end: hand-crafted Harris/ORB corner detection on real RGB, real depth at the corner pixel, GT-pose nearest-vertex association (identical to the dense baseline), same RANSAC plane and same layer. No learned detector, no descriptor matching, no appearance model. The GT-pose association keeps the clean absolute errors optimistic; the comparison isolates the front-end's point choice and density.
